title: game/data/music.json: the songs, the jingles, the cries' bases and where each song plays (sound track SND-2; game/js/audio/tracker.js, logic/music-where.js)

uiPick.description: SND-6: the buttons that make this sound: by class (a kit button's kind counts) or by data-a

wave.description: p12, p25, p50: pulse waves of 12.5, 25 and 50 %; or one of the browser's own

line.description: a written line of notes: [step from the song's start (16 a bar), midi note, length in steps]

key.description: the home note, as a midi note (60 is middle C)

prog.description: the chord of each bar, as a scale degree from 0 (I) to 6 (vii); eight bars

seed.description: the lead's random walk starts here: the same seed, the same tune

swing.description: how late every other sixteenth plays, as a share of a sixteenth

echo.description: how much of the lead goes to the echo (0.15 when left out)

trim.description: SND-8b: the song's level in dB (0 when left out), set from the loudness report (tools/check-sound.py --loudness) so the songs sit level with each other; the night and tense versions keep it unless they write their own

seventh.description: 1: the arpeggios and chords add the seventh

extra.description: SND-4: keep the thicker mix (sine arps and chords, the night pad) instead of four voices; the title and the fall only

pluck.description: SND-4: a music-box lead: every note short, with no vibrato (Copperleaf)

arpOctave.description: SND-5: lift the arp by octaves (the run's later rows)

counterAuto.description: SND-5: with no counter written, make one from the hook (each note on a chord tone a third or more below it; the run's last rows)

ensemble.description: SND-11: the ensemble that plays the song (music.json ensembles), or gb: today's four chip voices (a reserved id, never an ensemble's). Left out: gb. A night, tense or arc version may name its own. Settings -> Sound -> GB Sounds plays every song as gb

instrument.description: SND-11: a baked instrument (logic/sound-bake.js renders its zones through the tracker's bank; synth only, never a sound file). Each kind reads its own keys; the others are left out

name.description: what it is, for the Studio

kind.description: pluck: a Karplus-Strong string; fm: two operators (a third, the tine); partials: struck sines (bars, bells, timpani); stack: detuned oscillators (strings, reeds, a choir, brass); wind: harmonics and breath (a flute, a clarinet, a bass); hit: a drum or a shaken thing

every.description: a zone (one baked note) every this many semitones

seed.description: its noise's seed (the same seed, the same sound)

sec.description: seconds a zone lasts (pluck: at middle C)

t60.description: pluck, fm: seconds to fall 60 dB

pick.description: pluck: where it is plucked (a share of the string)

tone.description: pluck: the output's low-pass (Hz); hit: the tone's level

ratio.description: fm: the modulator against the note

index.description: fm: the modulation at the start

indexEnd.description: fm: the modulation at the end

tine.description: fm: a third operator's index (the e-piano's bark)

tineRatio.description: fm: the tine against the note

tineTau.description: fm: seconds the tine takes to die (to 1/e)

list.description: partials: [ratio to the note, amplitude, seconds to fall to 1/e]

d.description: stack, wind: decay to the sustain (s, to 1/e)

s.description: stack, wind: the sustain's level (0: a one-shot, never looped)

click.description: partials, hit: a tick of noise at the strike

bend.description: partials: how far above the note a drum starts (a share)

bendTau.description: partials: seconds the bend takes to settle

cents.description: stack: one voice per offset from the note, in cents

track.description: stack: the cutoff as a multiple of the note

base.description: stack: Hz added to the tracked cutoff

formants.description: stack: a vowel's band-passes [Hz, Q, gain] in place of the low-pass (a choir)

vib.description: stack, wind: the vibrato's depth (a share of the pitch)

vibDelay.description: stack, wind: seconds before the vibrato comes in

scoop.description: stack: cents under the note at the start (brass)

open.description: stack: how far the filter opens at the start (x the cutoff, over 1)

openTau.description: stack: seconds the opening takes to close

noise.description: stack: a breath of noise; hit: the noise's level

hold.description: stack, wind: seconds of the sustain that loop while a note is held

fade.description: stack, wind: seconds of the loop's crossfade

harmonics.description: wind: the amplitude of the 1st, 2nd, 3rd... harmonic

breathAt.description: wind: the breath's band, a multiple of the note

chiff.description: wind: a puff of noise at the start

from.description: hit: the tone's Hz at the strike

to.description: hit: the Hz it falls to

toneTau.description: hit: seconds the tone takes to die

noiseA.description: hit: seconds the noise takes to rise

noiseTau.description: hit: seconds the noise takes to die

metal.description: hit: metal partials (Hz): jingles, small bells

metalTau.description: hit: seconds the metal takes to die

shake.description: hit: how fast it is shaken (Hz)

ensemblePart.description: SND-11: one part of an ensemble: a line of the song played on an instrument (inst, baked), on a chip voice (wave, as the gb path plays it) or, for drums, on a kit, into its own stem

line.description: what it plays: lead (the tune, and a battle's intro), counter (the countermelody), bass (the bass pattern), arp (the arpeggio pattern), pad (the bar's chord, held), stabs (the chord, short, on beats 1 and the and of 3), timp (the root on the first bar of each four, a roll into the loop), drums (the drum pattern on a kit)

wave.description: a chip voice instead of an instrument (the chip lead, the signature)

oct.description: octaves up or down (0 when left out)

pan.description: left -1 to right 1 (centre when left out)

verb.description: its send to the reverb (none when left out)

style.description: a pattern of its own instead of the song's: bass (bounce, gallop, long, walk, drive, pedal), arp (up, updown, drip, chord7), drums (soft, skip, drive, march, bossa)

centre.description: pad, stabs: the chord sits within a fifth of this note (pad 62, stabs 58 when left out)

kit.description: drums: the instrument for each hit

ensemble.description: SND-11: an ensemble, Chip+ meets DS-era: the parts that play a song in place of the four chip voices

name.description: what it is, for the Studio

trim.description: dB on top of the song's own trim, so the ensemble sits where the song's gb version does (the loudness report)

hook.description: SND-4: a written hook for bars 1-2 (none yet: the lead is composed)

counter.description: SND-4: a countermelody under the hook (none yet)

intro.description: SND-5: one or two bars on the lead alone that play once before the song when a battle starts it (the chromatic run); steps 0-31

night.description: SND-4: the night version (played outdoors at night, logic/music-where.js songVariant): the recipe's changes. With none written, 8 bpm slower, a fourth down, soft drums (audio/tracker.js trackerNight). false: no night version (battle songs, indoor songs, the title)

tense.description: SND-5: the tense version of a battle song (played while the lead Billie is under a quarter of its HP, logic/music-where.js songVariant): the recipe's changes. With none written, 16 bpm faster, march drums, a pedal bass (audio/tracker.js trackerTense). false: no tense version

hookName.description: SND-4: a name for the hook and its countermelody. Claude's drafts start with "placeholder" (the Studio's Check lists them)

arc.description: SND-5: false: the run's arc bands (music.json run.arc) leave this song as written

notes.description: [midi note, length in sixteenths]; a rest is note 0

bpm.description: SND-6: its tempo (150 when left out), as sound.js jinglePlay plays it

wave.description: SND-6: the lead's wave (p25 when left out)

name.description: SND-4: a name for the jingle. Claude's drafts start with "placeholder" (the Studio's Check lists them)

ensemble.description: SND-17: the ensemble that plays it (music.json ensembles) in place of the chip lead and its triangle, once its notes are baked and while GB Sounds is off; "gb" or none: the 8-bit jingle. Each part reads a line of the jingle: lead and counter the tune, pad the harmony held, stabs it short, arp its chords broken upward, bass the bass, drums the perc's kit notes, timp its other notes

harmony.description: SND-17: chords under the tune for the ensemble's pad, stabs and arp parts (notes starting on the same step make a chord)

bass.description: SND-17: the bass line for the ensemble's bass parts

perc.description: SND-17: hits by step: General MIDI drum notes (35, 36 kick; 37, 39 rim; 38, 40 snare; 42, 44, 46 hat) on the ensemble's kit, any other note on its timpani

stinger.description: SND-17: a short sting over a song (a Perk, the map's reveal, a day, a coin): as its ensemble it starts on the song's next beat, moves into the song's key (written in C) and drops the song's busy parts (the tune, the counter, the arpeggio) under it instead of ducking all of it. Without: the song ducks to 0.15 (the battle's fanfares)

bases.description: SND-6: the base cries by kind (beast, bird, ...); a species names one in lines/*.json cry, with its own pitch and length (logic/cries.js)

name.description: a name for the cry. Claude's drafts start with "placeholder" (the Studio's Check lists them)

at.description: when it starts, in seconds from the cry's start (x the species' length)

slide.description: where the note ends, x its frequency (1: no slide)

vib.description: a wobble's depth: 1 is 1.2 % of the note, at 5.5 Hz (0: none)

ui.description: SND-6: the buttons' four sounds and which button makes which (logic/ui-sounds.js); UI-16a: four for the UI's motions (a sheet opening, a card flip, a count-up's end, a toast); SY-3: stamp, the thunk when a pb-stamp lands

name.description: Claude's drafts start with "placeholder" (the Studio's Check lists them)

instruments.description: SND-11: the baked instruments by id (an ensemble's part and the battle sounds name one; the ids stay stable)

ensembles.description: SND-11: the ensembles by id; gb is reserved (today's four chip voices, the code's own)

mix.description: SND-6: the mix: each bus's trim (x the square of its Settings slider; logic: audio/levels.js) and the compressor on the master

master.description: the master's trim (0.9 leaves headroom for the compressor)

sfx.description: the sound effects bus (jingles, cries, the buttons)

world.description: the world sounds (water, fire, rain, animals)

bedsUnderSong.description: dB the world and ambience beds come down while a four-voice song plays (0: not at all)

run.description: SND-5: the run's music (logic/music-where.js musicArcBand, audio/tracker.js trackerArc)

arc.description: bands of a run's rows (row 0 is the landing) and the changes to a biome's song there; a song plays as 'meadow@mid'

name.description: the band's name, the song's part ('meadow@late'); not night or tense

changes.description: the recipe's changes in these rows

weather.description: the low-pass on the music (Hz) for each weather on a run's map tab (logic/music-where.js musicWeatherCut); weather not named plays open

where.description: which song plays: the first rule whose every key matches wins; a rule with only a song matches always

started.description: false: before the game has started (the title, the opening)

battle.description: the kind of battle: wild, trainer, rival (Chad), leader (a run's mini-boss), boss (a run's boss)

tab.description: the open tab (map: the world map)

placeKind.description: the place is a city or a town (locations.json t: city, town)

row.description: SND-5: a run's rows, from and to (1 is the landing)

song.description: a song of songs; $place: the place's own song (locations.json music), when it has one
